topic: Data API and facility group units
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical planning regarding data access. It was discussed that the time required for a specific project component should be estimated as three days, starting from a defined project start date.

Regarding the data structure, it was suggested that if [me] showed where the units are in mops, [p1] might be able to implement them within the data-api or create a shared package. However, [me] stated this approach would not work.

[p1] expressed an intention to take full ownership of the data-api to assist [me], but [me] suggested that if there is a release tomorrow, the implementation could be scheduled for the following week.
decisions: The time allocation for the project component should be three days starting from the official project start date.
